summary_1line: Rishis praise Krishna as supreme; cosmic signs follow Shiva’s speech; Bhishma explains Krishna’s divinity, Arjuna’s victory, and Time’s role in the war.

image_candidates.scene_text: Thunder roars and lightning flashes as dark clouds cover the sky above the Himalayan mountain where the Rishis had been listening to Mahadeva.
The immense serpent Ananta with many hoods supports the entire earth upon his head in the nether regions.
The assembled Rishis bow and circumambulate Krishna before departing, while he stands radiant among them.
